notes.title: New Event "New Saga in Alchemy World ～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/b79b375a2b3bdafd321f08c0f403386ed0d5455d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Following the divine message, the explorers set out to fight the threat from another world.
Thanks to their efforts defeating the black Yoromis, the otherworldly influence on this world began to fade.
It seemed only a matter of time before Kyle and Sildonia could safely return home.
However, a new divine message arrives: a fresh crisis has emerged, and the effects of the other world have begun to grow once again...

What is this new threat?
Will Kyle and Sildonia truly be able to return to their world safely?

Everything now rests on the explorers' shoulders...!!
The second half of the "New Saga" collab event starts!
[/p][h2]Dates (JST)[/h2][p]Start: 2025/8/13 (Wed) 17:00
End: 2025/9/3 (Wed) 13:59
[/p][h2]How to Participate[/h2][p][b]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/b]
Accept the event "New Saga in Alchemy World" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!
1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "New Saga in Alchemy World" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[b]② Defeat the Area Boss and collect items![/b]
You need "Small Silver Key x1" to fight the Area Boss!
Trade "Nightmare Remnant" at Komitt's Exchange!
The "Nightmare Remnant" will drop when you defeat "Black Yoromi"!
*There is no reward for defeating the Area Boss on Hell level.

[b]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Nightmare" and trade them for various prizes![/b]
*"Dream Crystal x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

Event Panel Mission is here!
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.
*You will receive an item box containing one full set of the Theron avatar in a random color.
*Using the item box will give you the avatar items.
*Please note that the event panel mission will end at the same time as the event.

[/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e704f93d2a19f2f9a337f96f605ef2585974f387.jpg"][/img]
[b]The special rewards for this event are a Theron's Sword and Urza's Dagger!![/b]
Get them and take nice pictures![/p][p]
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/19b3fac98685cd8ab8ee9fae0a2e01fc5e5ef71d.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/42b374ea78f625835fcde901015bf6f4ad86fe10.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[/p][h2]Notes[/h2][p]*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

©2025 Masayuki Abe,AlphaPolis/New Saga Production Committee[/p]

notes.title: New Area Boss! July 2 Update!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e350d520f7e7dadf328053aa63a279527876a6f1.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Area Boss "Feral Dasha" Arrives![/b][/h2][p]New Area Boss "Feral Dasha" Arrives![/p][p]The Area Boss "Dasha" from the Krishna Kingdom appears even more powerful as "Feral Dasha"![/p][p]Team up with your friends and challenge the overwhelming queen who wields the power of many elements![/p][p]*You can participate in a party of up to 8 people. (YOME will not participate)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Requirements[/b][/h3][p]・Clear the quest "\[N] Save The Queen".[/p][p]・Your current job must be Lv 71 or above.[/p][p]・You need "Dark Magic Stone".[/p][p]*You can get "Dark Magic Stones" by defeating the regular Dasha.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Irregular Wave Battle[/b][/h3][p]The battle against "Feral Dasha" consists of a total of five waves, and players cannot revive in the fifth (final) wave.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Feral Dasha Drop Items[/b][/h3][p]Feral Dasha drops materials to awaken fully enhanced Idea series weapons.[/p][p]The awakened weapons are greatly boosted with even more powerful abilities.[/p][p]*Upon your first successful defeat, you can obtain enough materials to awaken one weapon via Achievements.[/p]

notes.title: New Event "Shark Wedding ～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/331ad6e3bc3a8a2325afe68d4626dc82e5f2485f.png"][/img][/p][p]They say a June wedding brings happiness.[/p][p]── And thanks to that tradition from another world, couples book their weddings at the church this time of year.[/p][p][/p][p]But someone seems to be targeting these happy couples. With Mamonos showing up near the venue, explorers have been called in to guard the ceremonies.[/p][p][/p][p]Step in and keep the weddings safe!

[/p][h2]Dates (JST)[/h2][p]Start: 2025/6/11 (Wed) 17:00[/p][p]End: 2025/7/16 (Wed) 13:59

[/p][h2]How to Participate[/h2][h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3][p]Accept the event "Shark Wedding" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.[/p][p]2. Accept "Shark Wedding" from the Event tab.[/p][p]3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.[/p][p]*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[/p][h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3][p]You will have a chance to get "Fukami Fin" and "Fukami Liver" by defeating certain Mamonos on the event map.
[/p][table colwidth=",,81"][tr][th][p]Area[/p][/th][th][p]Lv[/p][/th][th colwidth="81"][p]Mamono[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Part 1: Beg[/p][/td][td][p]-[/p][/td][td colwidth="81"][p]Fukami[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Part 1: Int[/p][/td][td][p]-[/p][/td][td colwidth="81"][p]Fukami[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Part 1: Adv[/p][/td][td][p]-[/p][/td][td colwidth="81"][p]Fukami[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Part 1: Super[/p][/td][td][p]Lv60 or higher[/p][/td][td colwidth="81"][p]Fukami[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Part 1: Hell[/p][/td][td][p]Lv70 or higher[/p][/td][td colwidth="81"][p]Fukami[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/7a18316994bfa59999c9907596219c060f636219.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3][p]*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[/p][h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2][p]You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[/p][h2]Event limited item[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/129a079b2a5fe50e528ea3f20faca5771f2bf8fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The special rewards for this event are a Bow Frame \[Love] and S Bubble \[Congrats]!![/p][p]Get them and take nice pictures!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/ec59423e20b2029cf4d3bf881e41356518a7a52e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/1f8315114701334086e9c133027ab181af338fb0.png"][/img] [/p][h3]Notes[/h3][p]*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.[/p]

notes.title: March 19 update details!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/967543233add383e4d4ab2e31a8ba392114c217a.jpg[/img]
We're announcing the contents of our March 19 update!

[h2]Update[/h2]
◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2
◆Additional Core Slot Feature
◆Twin Core Feature

[h2]◆Added 2 new chapters for Main Story Part 2[/h2]
*There are no voices in this quest.


[h2]Additional Core Slot Feature[/h2]
This feature allows you to add core slots to some equipment beyond the maximum limit.
Equipment has 0-5 core slots, but the number can be increased by using a special drill.

[h2]About the necessary items to open additional core slots[/h2]
You need a special "Bore Drill" to open additional core slots.
You can get Bore Drills for example from Twin Grande Gacha.


[h2]About Bore Drill types[/h2]
There are several types and rarities of the Bore Drill.
The type and rarity of the drill affect the equipment it can open and the success rate of slot expansion.

Ex)
・Bore Drill+ [1H Sword]: You can open an additional core slot in a random color on the selected "1H Sword" at a 100% probability.
・Bore Drill [Staff]: You can open an additional slot in a random color on a "Staff" at a 10% probability.

[h2]About the equipment in which you can open additional core slots[/h2]
You can open an additional core slot on the following equipment.

・Some Legendary weapons
・Some UR equipment (head, top, bottoms)

[h2]How to open additional core slots[/h2]
You can use this feature by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".

You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Open Slots menu.


[h2]About Twin Cores[/h2]
This item is combined by two colors, such as Red+Red or Red+Blue.
Unlike standard cores, Twin Cores take up two adjacent core slots when set, but they offer incredibly powerful effects.


[h3]LV1 Twin Core Abilities[/h3]

Recovery+：Wind DEF20％[max 200][/td][/tr][/table]

*The level-based stat increases, synthesis cost, and synthesis success rate of Twin Cores differ from those of standard cores and High Cores.

You can get Twin Cores for example from Twin Grande Gacha.

[h2]How to set Twin Cores[/h2]
Just like standard cores, you can set Twin Cores by talking to NPC Sumina in the Enhancement Center after clearing the sub-quest "Enhancement Center".


You can get to the Enhancement Center from the southern border (on the State of Abul side).
You can also access it from YOME > Gear Enhancement > Core Set menu.

To set a Twin Core, you need two open core slots arranged in the same order as the Twin Core's colors.

Ex) Twin Core Red+Blue:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Blue.
*You can't set in a Blue+Red core slot.

Twin Core Red+Red:
You need a core slot that's open in the order of Red+Red.
*You can't set if the order is Red+Blue+Red, etc., where the colors are not next to each other.

notes.title: New Event "Marriage Festival!～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/2bff2db9177f1c16e14746b554f507b80e609e39.jpg[/img]
June - the most popular time of the year for weddings.
However, so many couples wanted to get married that there were not enough churches to hold the ceremonies.
In order to overcome the situation, the church plans a large-scale wedding “Marriage Festival".
As a venue for the festival, the church decided to use a luxury cruise ship that had been used for weddings in the past.
The explorers explained the situation to Bocar and he promised to lend the ship.
However, the ship had not been used since the wedding last time, so they went to check if it was ready for use...

Will the "Marriage Festival" be able to start?!

*Check the past event "Wedding on a Cruise Ship" to enjoy this event more.
(You can check it from the Album even if you haven't joined the event)

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2024/6/12 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2024/7/10 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "Marriage Festival!" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Marriage Festival!" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3]
You will have a chance to get "Pirate Gem" and "Rare Pirate Gem" by defeating certain Mamonos on the event map.
[table][tr][th]Area[/th][th]Lv[/th][th]Mamono[/th][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Beg[/td][td]-[/td][td]Pirate Rabber[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Int[/td][td]-[/td][td]Pirate Rabber[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Adv[/td][td]-[/td][td]Pirate Rabber[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Super[/td][td]Lv60 or higher[/td][td]Pirate Rabber[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Hell[/td][td]Lv70 or higher[/td][td]Pirate Rabber[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3]
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[h2]Event limited item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/62f5d4e40d016adfabdb448d04987f6607b4014a.jpg[/img]
The special rewards for this event are Pink Party clothes and Silver Tiara!!
Get them and take nice pictures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/bdb6b9f97883fc8030de4bcb4fec58b28ab9d183.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/29d241c9f6223459afd9bb3c49f1e73ad75deb19.png[/img]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/5990bc2b1347d98ca853bc048745221c107c0d68.png[/img]
Alchemia Story will celebrate its 6th anniversary on May 30, 2024!
To thank everyone who has supported us, we have prepared a wonderful campaign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/93f81706621d783d842d8cf9b3b99a7616590b60.png[/img]

6th Release Anniversary! "Once a Day Free 10x Gacha" Now Available!
Don’t forget to draw every day!
In addition, on May 30 you can draw 10x10, a total of 100 draws! Don't miss this chance!

[h3]About "Once a Day Free 10x Gacha"[/h3]
*You can do one 10x draw every day for free.

[h2]6th Release Anniversary Fan Art Contest Starts![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/6012fedaf67d485ef93400738e2279c5bc948170.jpg[/img]

Fan Art Contest to celebrate Alchemia Story's 6th release anniversary starts!
One "Grand Winner" and "Honorable Mention" will be selected in each of the three categories: Illustration, Screenshot, and Craft.
The winning works will be implemented as furniture items in the game!
We are looking forward to your entries!

[h3]Categories[/h3]
◆Illustration
Post a clear photo of your digital or analog drawing with the hashtags: #AlchemiaFanArt #Illustration

*We do not accept AI-generated pictures and pictures that infringe on the rights of other companies.

◆Screenshot
Post your screenshots taken in the game with the hashtags #AlchemiaFanArt #Screenshot

*We do not accept screenshots that are taken by using malfunctions or screenshots that include items from past collaboration events with other companies.

◆Craft
Post photos of handmade items, objects, food, etc. with the hashtags #AlchemiaFanArt #Craft

*We do not accept pictures with items that infringe on the rights of other companies.

[h3]Application period[/h3]
Start: 2024/5/15 (Wed) 18:00

Result announcement: On a later day on Bemmo Channel

notes.content:
[h2]New Area Boss "Buccaneer" arrives![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/368a7e52fef1d54f69d6895085baca3bc1f43d89.jpg[/img]

The powerful Area Boss - "Buccaneer" has appeared in the Underground Factory 5F!
Those who win the battles against the powerful Buccaneer might get materials and rare accessories...
Face this overwhelming power together with your friends!
*You need 3 Area Boss Tickets to fight.

[h2]Conditions[/h2]
・You must clear the quest "[N] New Organization"
・Your current job must be Lv 70 or above.
・You need 3 "Area Boss Tickets".

[h2]Buccaneer Drop Items[/h2]
[h3]Rune Compatible Earrings[/h3]
You can carve Runes to the accessories that Buccaneer drops!
You can also create powerful Runes with the Rune materials that Buccaneer drops!

[h3]Magic Coin [Platinum][/h3]
You can use it to create special Runes.

[h3]Rune Materials[/h3]
Collect Buccaneer's materials and create powerful Runes.
*Deck in the Enhancement Center will exchange them for Runes.

[h3]Rune Ability examples[/h3]
・Boosts the ability that increases hate druing action
・Boosts the ability and boosts the ability even further according to the number of times skills are used
You'll have a chance get the above abilities and more!

notes.content:

Explorers keep defeating Chocopas, who are after the chocolate at the party venue.

Right when you thought the party could end without further trouble...
Cocowoof A's plot, which he had been preparing in the shadows, was revealed and a new threat appeared...!

Will the explorers be able to defeat Cocowoof A and his ambitions?!

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "The Sweet Scent of Danger" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "The Sweet Scent of Danger" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Defeat Area Boss "Chocolisk" and collect items![/h3]
You need "Melty Chocolate" to fight the Area Boss!
Trade "Hard Chocolate" Cocowoof's Exchange!
You can get "Hard Chocolate" by defeating Chocopa!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Chocolisk" in Hell level.

[h3]③ Get items from the event Mamonos and "Chocolisk" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "Chocolate Decoration x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/6fa1305dd8ff3f6a2bc73c13d3bf1cdab8ec6794.png[/img]

notes.title: Teamwork! "Bond Hideouts" are here! December 20 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/0b94e12e19282978a71e348eb37c60001af7dc22.jpg[/img]
[h2]What are "Hideouts"?[/h2]
This feature allows you and your Bond members to build your own Hideout.
You can also obtain Hideout EXP and Hideout Points by completing "Bond Quests", which are implemented at the same time as the Hideout feature.
The "Boost" function activates by using the "Hideout Points" and gives you various buff effects.
As your Hideout level increases, the amount of "Boost" buffs increases, and the rewards for "Bond Quests" change.


[h2]Hideout Information[/h2]
You can see HIdeout information from Menu > Interact > Bond.

[h3]Hideout Status[/h3]
You can check details about your Hideout.
Bond Name　　　　　　・・・Name of your current Bond
Hideout Level　　　　・・・Current Hideout level
HIdeouit Points　　　・・・HIdeout Points your Bond currently has
My Hideout Points　・・・My Hideout Points you currently have
Current EXP　　　　・・・Total of current Hideout EXP
Until Next Lv　　　・・・Amount of Hideout EXP required to level up
You can also check the Boosts you've learned at each level and those currently in effect.

[h3]Boost[/h3]
You can activate Boosts.
You can also check the Boosts that are currently activated.
Bond Quests
You can check details about Bond Quests.


[h2]What are "Boosts"?[/h2]
You can access Boosts from Menu > Interact > Hideout Information > Boost.
There are two types of Boosts: "Overall" and "Individual"
Overall Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need 100 Hideout Points to activate one Boost.
By activating the Boost, all Bond members will get the effects.
The Boost is activated for 24 hours.
Individual Boost
You can activate up to 3 Boosts.
You need My Hideout Points to activate a Boost.
You can activate one Boost for 1 hour with 10 My Hideout Points. (If you want to activate a Boost for a longer time, you are charged more points. )
You can activate them for up to 100 hours.

[h2]About the function to manage permissions to change Hideout boosts[12/27 Update][/h2]
You can check boost permissions via Menu> Interact> Bond> Change Permissions.
The bond leader can grant permission to activate Hideout boosts to each bond member.
*All members' permissions will be disabled as default.
*Permissions can be changed by the bond leader.

[h2]What are "Bond Quests"?[/h2]
You can access Bond Quests from Menu > Interact > Bond > Bond Quest.
There are weekly "Co-op Quests" that you can play with your Bond members, as well as daily "Solo Quests" that you can play by yourself.

[h3]Co-op Quests[/h3]
You can play the selected quest with your Bond members each week.
The quests and rewards you can get change by the Bond level.
*Co-op Quests update every Monday at 0:00 JST.
*The Bond level you have by Sunday at 20:00 JST will be reflected.
*The quest status will reset during the update.
*Even if there is a similar quest after the update, your previous progress will not be transferred.
*If a Mamono is defeated while being in the same party with the same Bond members, the progress level will not be duplicated.
*About new Bond members
┗The quest is automatically accepted from the next update after the member has joined.
┗New members won't get the rewards from the week they joined.
┗If you leave the Bond before receiving your reward and rejoin the same Bond, you will become a new Bond member and will not receive the reward for that week's Co-op Quest.

[h3]◆Co-op Quest Rewards[/h3]
Rewards can be received when the Bond Leader presses the receive button on the Co-op Quest list.
Hideout Points, Hideout EXP, and Bond Donations will be added to your Bond when you receive the rewards.
Other rewards will be sent to the Limited Time Reward Box.

[h3]Solo Quests[/h3]
Daily quests for Bond members to play by themselves.
Only the player who clears the quests can receive the rewards.
The rewards will be sent directly to your bag after pressing the receive button.
*About rejoining a Bond
┗If you leave the Bond and rejoin it before completing the Solo Quests or receiving the rewards, your status will be carried over.
┗If you leave the Bond after receiving the Solo Quest rewards and then rejoin the Bond, your Solo Quest status will be carried over.
┗Individual points you got before leaving the Bond will be carried over when you rejoin another Bond.

*The quest status will reset during the update.
*Even if there is a similar quest after the update, your previous progress will not be transferred.
*If a Mamono is defeated while being in the same party with the same Bond members, the progress level will not be duplicated.
*About new Bond members
┗The quest is automatically accepted from the next update after the member has joined.
┗New members won't get the rewards from the week they joined.
┗If you leave the Bond before receiving your reward and rejoin the same Bond, you will become a new Bond member and will not receive the reward for that week's Co-op Quest.
◆Co-op Quest Rewards
Rewards can be received when the Bond Leader presses the receive button on the Co-op Quest list.
Hideout Points, Hideout EXP, and Bond Donations will be added to your Bond when you receive the rewards.
Other rewards will be sent to the Limited Time Reward Box.
Solo Quests
Daily quests for Bond members to play by themselves.
Only the player who clears the quests can receive the rewards.
The rewards will be sent directly to your bag after pressing the receive button.
*About rejoining a Bond
┗If you leave the Bond and rejoin it before completing the Solo Quests or receiving the rewards, your status will be carried over.
┗If you leave the Bond after receiving the Solo Quest rewards and then rejoin the Bond, your Solo Quest status will be carried over.
┗Individual points you got before leaving the Bond will be carried over when you rejoin another Bond.

notes.title: Become even stronger! "Tower of Time: Night" is here! December 6 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9dd9528d60560691f26ba16ffd41a67b417db16c.jpg[/img]
[h2]What's "Tower of Time: Night"?[/h2]
It's a new solo feature where players can strengthen their rank 3 and extra jobs.
Together with your YOME, you can reach the higher floors while defeating enemies, which enables you to strengthen your status and skills.
Each floor's enhancement rewards can only be received once per week, and the acquisition history and achievements reset every Monday at 0:00 JST.

[h2]Conditions[/h2]
・You must have accepted the quest "Let's Climb The Tower!"
・You must clear the quest "Request for Cokes"
・Your current job must be Lv 90 or above.

When you move to the Tower of Time 1F while meeting the above conditions, you can accpet the exclusive quest "Tower of the Night".
After that, you can proceed from the movement point in the Tower of Time 2F to the Tower of Time: Night 1F. (*Only if your current job is at level 90)
After moving, the entrance to the next floor is closed, and you can only enter it by defeating the enemies there.

[h2]About "Tower of Time: Night"[/h2]
At the beginning of a battle, a damage restriction is added to the enemies in the Tower of Time: Night, preventing you from dealing more than a certain amount of damage.
Look for ways to relax or remove the restricition and be creative in how you fight to aim for bigger damage!
Also, you cannot revive during the battles at the Tower of Time: Night, so make sure to fight in cooperation with your YOME to avoid being defeated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e1e614e2ebd1877444dd52707903c9f1c6cc740a.jpg[/img]
Damage restriction icon


[h2]Rewards[/h2]
By defeating the enemies on the regular floors, you can get "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" , "Soul Shard", and "Coins" based on your current job.
You can get these once per week per floor.
In addition, at the boss floors located every fifth floor, when you win the battle and use "Soul Shard" you can get a "Soul" based on your current job.
Even if you go to the next floor without using a "Soul Shard", you can use it and get the "Soul" if you retry the battle.
*You can choose to use the "Soul Shard" only at the end of a battle if you win. There is no weekly limit to the rewards you can get when using it.

[h2]Passive Skill Acquistion, Item Trade[/h2]
The "Coin", "Soul", and "Time Skip Coin (Dusk)" you get can be traded for passive skills and items at the Merchant's Exchange in the Tower of Time 2F.
The passive skills enhance your status and also boost the effects when enhancing skills or getting buffs from your allies.
*You can trade passive skills only once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/95074044435d0bc3936eb37b40b234f9f6ab0525.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Event "Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/2ac8258986c3f76a53d7dd1809c6a3dc0f0d9d0b.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)?[/h2]
Spirit Wars is a limited One-Time Party that you can challenge with level 70+ Jobs.

When you win in the battle, you'll get materials to create a powerful "Spirit Weapon".
*YOME will not join the Spirit Wars.
Find more details about One-Time Party here

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/ca3dbbc6f4bf3d049225336f7b37d39df32a5ac6.png[/img]

[h2]Period(JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/9/6 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/9/20 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]Requirements to join "Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit)"[/h2]
・Level 70 or above
・Cleared Ch.87 Windy Mission
・The following items (the required amount depends on the level)
　┗[Adv / Adv+] : Wind Amphibole x3
　┗[Hell] : Wind Amphibole x5

If you meet the requirements above, you can join from Navi > One-Time Party > Event.
You can also join from Navi > Event.

[h2]About the required items to challenge the Spirit Wars[/h2]
Defeat Beg/Int "Teba-King" to get 1 of the items that you need to challenge the Spirit Wars.
*You need an Area Boss Tix to fight the Beg/Int Boss.

[h3]Bosses who drop the items[/h3]
[Beg] Teba-King: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 1 Wind Amphibole
[Int] Teba-King: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 2 Wind Amphiboles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/e736dd09300df1eaa569cf09af89a374f17a36fc.png[/img]



[h2]About Spirit Weapons[/h2]
Collect materials in the Spirit Wars to trade Spirit Weapons at "Liz's Mystical Shop".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/a19cd95cfb403661858344f19079d20ade310f98.png[/img]

Awakened Spirit Weapons will have special effects on their appearance, and in rare cases, they will deal additional damage based on their Wind element value.
*The Awakening materials will drop only at "Hell" level.

[h3]Weapons that can be created with Spirit Wars (Wind Spirit) materials[/h3]
・【1-handed Axe】Elemental Hawk
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Hawk W
・【Bow】Elemental Shooter
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Shooter W
・【Knuckles】Elemental Jamadhars
　┗【Awakened】Elemental Jamadhars W

[h2]Added katana to Spirit Weapons[/h2]
You can make katanas with "Sumina" at the Enhancement Center after collecting the necessary materials.
Learn more about katanas here

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the katana][/h3]
・Wind Arms Shard [KTN]

[h3][Weapons that you can make with materials from Spirit Wars (Flame Spirit)][/h3]
・ [KTN]Soul Katana of Wind
　┗[After forging]Soul Katana of Wind X

[h2]Added item drops for learning Receptor skills![/h2]
Defeat the target enemy as a Receptor to get the drops.
You can learn the skills by trading a special skill item with Rein in front of the Enhancement Center,

[h3][Items that you can get at Spirit Wars][/h3]
・R: Heal Wind

notes.title: New Event "Horror of Sunday the 31st～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/086cb448e0bc2035ddfad4952b7531f63b6f6ed4.png[/img]
Steve invited the explorers to his camp.
Steve is proud of the safety measures he has taken, and the other visitors are enjoying the camp.
However, that night, Steve told a ghost story to the visitors who were fed up with the heat, and the next morning, something unusual happened!!

Is the new Mamono from the one from the ghost story?!
What is they key to defeating these Mamonos?!
──The summer of terror begins...

*Check past event "The Camp of the Dead" from Album to enjoy this event more.
(You can check it from the Album even if you didn't join the event in the past)

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/8/9 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/9/6 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "Horror of Sunday the 31st" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Horror of Sunday the 31st" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3]
You will have a chance to get "Curse Remnant" and "Curse Remnant [D]" by defeating certain Mamonos on the event map.
[table][tr][th]Area[/th][th]Lv[/th][th]Mamono[/th][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Beg[/td][td]-[/td][td]Soul Servant[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Int[/td][td]-[/td][td]Soul Servant[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Adv[/td][td]-[/td][td]Soul Servant[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Super[/td][td]Lv60 or higher[/td][td]Soul Servant[/td][/tr][tr][td]Part 1: Hell[/td][td]Lv70 or higher[/td][td]Soul Servant[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3]
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h3]Event Panel Mission is here![/h3]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.

※We have confirmed an issue that when the contents of the Limited Time Reward Box are on more than one page, the item at the bottom of the previous page appears on the next page when the item is received on the last page.

[h3]Limited Time Reward Box Feature[/h3]
This feature allows players to receive specific rewards that they were unable to receive due to disconnection or other reasons. The items will be stored for a certain period of time and the players will be able to receive them.

[h3]Rewards that can be stored[/h3]
・Reward for defeating a Boss in Party Dungeons
・Reward for defeating Mamonos in Tower of Time Basement
・Reward for defeating Area Bosses
・Reward for defeating Bosses in Spirit Wars

[h3]How to receive the rewards[/h3]
・After meeting the requirements for storing the reward, it can be received from the "Limited Time Box" icon.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
・You will not be able to receive the items after a certain period of time.
・Time will be counted during maintenance as well.
・Only rewards for defeating Mamonos will be stored. Quest rewards will not be stored.
・There is a limit to the number of items that can be stored in the Limited Time Reward Box. Once the limit is exceeded, the reward will not be stored even if the conditions are met.
If there are no items available in the Limited Time Reward Box, the icon for receiving items will not be displayed.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/cb2e40564d01fe52cc7fa4381533f4258455e4ed.jpg[/img]
The explorers were collecting back the stolen cargo.
In the midst of that, Liz finds a rare piece of Black Metal and gets excited over it.
However, it seems that the metal lures the Sea Intruders' bosses...

What's the Sea Intruders intention?
Will Liz be able to get her merchandise back and save her business?

The hidden truth is now revealed!

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/7/26 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/8/9 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "Creatures Under The Sea" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Creatures Under The Sea" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]②Defeat Area Boss "Sea Pirate" and collect items![/h3]
You need "Black Metal Pieces" to fight the Area Boss!
Trade them with "Stolen Wooden Box" at Liz's Exchange!
You can get "Stolen Wooden Boxes" by defeating Sea Intruders!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Sea Pirate" in Hell level.

[h3]③Get items from the event Mamonos and "Sea Pirate" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "Deep Sea Onyx x5" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]Event Panel Mission is here![/h2]

Get the event exclusive Mount and enjoy riding it!

notes.title: New Rank 3 Job "Death Bringer" is Here! July 5 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/a5405401884e7005717bb27c634c030dc8a4635f.jpg[/img]
New Rank 3 Job [Death Bringer] Added!
Let's welcome a new rank 3 job, "Death Bringer"!
Death Bringers are death in a human form. They bring death to those who are destined to die.

[h2]Conditions to Accept Rank 3 Job Quests[/h2]
Players are required to meet the following conditions to accept rank 3 job quests.
・Level up the rank 2 job to Lv 70 and clear the quest "About Rank 3 Jobs". You can accept it from Kaho.
*You can accept "About Rank 3 Jobs" after clearing the Main Quest Ch. 76 and Sub Quest "Tempting Astral Weapons".
・After clearing "About Rank 3 Jobs", you must have an UR or LR Akashic Weapon to take the pre-test of each rank 3 job.
*You can take the Pre-Test from NPC "Adventure Master" outside the Tower.


[h2]Requirements to change your job to a Death Bringer[/h2]
[h3]◆Job Quest Requirements[/h3]
・Clear "About Rank 3 Jobs"
・Pass the Pre-Test for Death Bringer
・Assassin Lv 70 or above
・You must have Akashic Weapon "Grave Usher" or "Grave Usher Ω"

[h3]◆Where to Change Jobs[/h3]
Accept the job quest for "Death Bringer" from Kaho at the Tavern in the State of Abul. After clearing it you can change your job.

[h2]Introducing Death Bringer skills![/h2]
[h3]◆Shadow Stitch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/7d5bcb3ca8fce2cf8fc4bde97e1ed9752c97e952.png[/img]
Physical damage to one enemy and extends the target's cast time. Adds Sky based on the order of attacks.

[h3]◆Dreamy Ice Slash[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/160915b76cefaf2052c239a714a821fd4928e738.png[/img]
Physical Water damage to one enemy. Adds Shadow or Illusion based on the order of attacks.

[h3]◆Universe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9605adb64d9bc3be726bca77bf4e4402367a2075.png[/img]
Reduces your cool time.vEnhances Earth/Sky/Shadow/Illusion added to you.

notes.title: New Event "King Lindow's Festival～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/a3741918ce262f1a6bca4f7fb0c0e92a276d13eb.png[/img]
Many Mamonos expecting a battle event gathered at the venue, but due to King Lindow's arrangements, in addition to the ball, they also decided to hold a tournament.

The festival was packed with guests.
However, the battle tournament that was decided in a hurry had some issues with deciding the rules...
What's King Lindow's plan to make the festival even more exciting?
And how will the festival end?!

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/6/28 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/7/12 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "King Lindow's Festival" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "King Lindow's Festival" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]②Defeat Area Boss "DJ Bro" and collect items![/h3]
You need "Tournament Badge" to fight the Area Boss!
You can get "Tournament Badges" by defeating Arabiwoofs!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "DJ Bro" in Hell level.

[h3]③Get items from the event Mamonos and "DJ Bro" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "5 DJ Battle Soul MAX" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item(s) will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h2]About Fishing[/h2]
You can catch fish at the fishing points on the event map.
Get event limited fishing baits at Kihada's Exchange and try fishing!

[h2]Event Limited Fishing Baits[/h2]
You can use the event limited fishing bait "Ball Stall Bait" only at the fishing points on the event map.
You will have better chances to catch certain fish when using the "Ball Stall Bait".

[h2]About Treasure Map[/h2]
Added new items to Treasure Hunt rewards from part 2!
You can get the limited treasure map with "20 Tournament Badges" from NPC "Lavi" on the event map.
*If you already have 1 Treasure Map, you can't trade any new maps.

[h2]Food Exchange[/h2]
You can trade food with event items from NPC "Taspa" on the event map.
You can also trade event limited accessories! Don't miss them!

[h2][Event Panel Mission is here!][/h2]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[h2]Event limited item[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/d00089ba04e633c9f84b0a911e45966ca6604451.png[/img]
The special rewards for this event are Lindow Hair Wig and Float!!
Get them and enjoy walking around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/f766bf8b298dc3898256044eb7ddc4aa9d60533c.png[/img]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.

notes.title: New Area Boss! June 21 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/182593d73af7a9bfbc699e2173ac3ffe6cd0d318.png[/img]

The powerful Area Boss - "Sylpha" has appeared in the Unsealed Forest!
Those who win the battles against the powerful Sylpha might get materials and rare accessories...
Face this overwhelming power together with your friends!
*You need 3 Area Boss Tickets to fight.

[h3]Conditions[/h3]
・You must clear the quest "[N] To the Unsealed Forest"
・Your current job must be Lv 70 or above.
・You need 3 "Area Boss Tickets".

[h3]Sylpha Drop Items[/h3]
[h3]Rune Compatible Earrings[/h3]
You can carve Runes to the accessories that Sylpha drops!
You can also create powerful Runes with the materials that Sylpha drops!

[h3]Magic Coin [Platinum][/h3]
You can use it to create special Runes.

[h3]Rune Materials[/h3]
You can also create powerful Runes with the materials that Sylpha drops!
*Deck in the Enhancement Center will exchange them for Runes.

[h3]Rune Ability examples[/h3]
・Extra damage triggers according to elemental ATK in exchange of reduced damage factor
・Increases DEF and MDEF, and also increases elemental DEF according to the damage taken in battle
You'll have a chance get the above abilities and more!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Added sub-quests！[/h2]
・Added 2 "Alchemia Record 2" chapters
┗"Imitator of God of Time"
┗"Goodbye Alchemia Guardians"

*You are able to accept quests of this series after clearing the Main Quest Ch. 65.
*Please note that you have to clear "Time Fortress Chronos" to accept this quest.
*There are no voices in this quest.

notes.title: New Event "Wedding Road Winners ～Part 2～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/135d880981dc498915d04613bcf4bbd04b4375e8.png[/img]
After beating the Robber Rabbers and getting back the stolen wedding gifts, the explorers are ready for the main round.
However, Micky said that the other seven pairs who had passed the first round were also quite strong.
Will the explorers be able to survive and win the tournament?

※We have confirmed an issue where players cannot get the "Eternal Bouquet" when clearing the event "Wedding Road Winners～Part 2～",
We have scheduled to fix this issue during the maintenance on June 7, and players who have cleared the event can get the item when moving to the "Part 2: Reception".

End: 2023/6/14 (Wed) 13:59

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Wedding Road Winners" from the Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]②Defeat Area Boss "Violent Bride" and collect items![/h3]
You need "Wedding Gift" to fight the Area Boss!
You can get "Wedding Gift" by defeating Robber Rabber!
*There is no reward for defeating Area Boss "Violent Bride" in Hell level.

[h3]③Get items from the event Mamonos and "Violent Bride" and trade them for various prizes![/h3]
*You need "5 Violent Bride's Silk" for 1 Play of the Box Gacha.
*Complete the event quest part 2 to play the Box Gacha.
*If you draw the Box Gacha, but you don't have any space in your bag, the item will be stored in your storage.
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h3][Event Panel Mission is here!][/h3]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/0a99433a742d5f71fac35ce208932ee8b3226f96.png[/img]

notes.title: Event "Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/2b60f35b0f74884efaeacde85dffe44cce5bca3e.png[/img]

What's Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)?
Spirit Wars is a limited One-Time Party that you can challenge with level 70+ Jobs.

When you win in the battle, you'll get materials to create a powerful "Spirit Weapon".
*YOME will not join the Spirit Wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/029a93c9c2eaf909404a9eece75bc65f9299c87f.png[/img]

[h2]Period(JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/5/10 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/5/24 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]Requirements to join "Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)"[/h2]
・Level 70 or above
・Cleared Ch. 82 Spirit Sword
・The following items (the required amount depends on the level)
┗[Adv / Adv+] : Earth Amphibole x3
┗[Hell] : Earth Amphibole x5

If you meet the requirements above, you can join from Navi > One-Time Party > Event.
You can also join from Navi > Event.

[h2]About the required items to challenge the Spirit Wars[/h2]
Defeat Beg/Int "Earth Servant" to get 1 of the items that you need to challenge the Spirit Wars.
*You need an Area Boss Tix to fight the Beg/Int Boss.

[h3]Bosses who drop the items[/h3]
[Beg] Earth Servant: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 1 Earth Amphibole
[Int] Earth Servant: If you succeed in defeating the Boss, it will drop 2 Earth Amphiboles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/029a93c9c2eaf909404a9eece75bc65f9299c87f.png[/img]

[h2]About Spirit Weapons[/h2]
Collect materials in the Spirit Wars to trade Spirit Weapons at "Liz's Mystical Shop".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/bc0235faa516974896a375a6ca1abc03e7abddea.png[/img]

Awakened Spirit Weapons will have special effects on their appearance, and in rare cases, they will deal additional damage based on their earth element value.
Also, awakened Spirit Weapon shields will have a reduced damage effect instead of the additional damage.
*The Awakening materials will drop only at "Hell" level.

[h3]Weapons that can be created with Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit) materials[/h3]
・[1H Sword]Elemental Sword
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Sword E
・[2H Axe]Elemental Hammer
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Hammer E
・[Shield]Elemental Shield
 ┗ [Awakened] Elemental Shield E

[h2]Added katana to Spirit Weapons[/h2]
You can make katanas with "Sumina" at the Enhancement Center after collecting the necessary materials.
Learn more about katanas here

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the katana][/h3]
・Earth Arms Shard [KTN]

[h3][Weapons that you can make with materials from Spirit Wars (Earth Spirit)][/h3]
・ [KTN]Soul Katana of Earth
 ┗ [After forging]Soul Katana of Earth X

[h2]Added item drops for learning Receptor skills![/h2]
Defeat the target enemy as a Receptor to get the drops.
You can learn the skills by trading a special skill item with Rein in front of the Enhancement Center,

[h3][New materials available at Spirit Wars with the addition of the item][/h3]
・R:Mystic Thunder Armor

notes.title: New Event "Mysteries of the Ruins～Part 1～" Starts!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/83ff76dc36264073760f59e8abe6aa2c02bbff16.png[/img]
The explorers are stopped by Richard in town.
It seems that a hole had appeared on the outskirts of the Duchy of Schlinger that led to a different dimension.
Richard sent out a team to investigate, and they found that the hole was connected to some ancient ruins.
They tried to investigate the area, but were forced to retreat when a pack of Mamonos appeared from the depths of the ruins.
He therefore asked the explorers to assist him in defeating the Mamonos and investigating.

The explorers accepted the request and headed for the ruins.
But what awaited them there...?
Will they be able to successfully accomplish this task?

[h2]Dates (JST)[/h2]
Start: 2023/4/12 (Wed) 18:00
End: 2023/5/10 (Wed) 13:59

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[h3]① Let's join the Event from NAVI![/h3]
Accept the event "Mysteries of the Ruins" from Navi and select "Move" to start the event!

1.Open "Navi" from the Menu on the left.
2. Accept "Mysteries of the Ruins" from Event tab.
3. Select "Move" to start the event story and move to the event map.
*Please note that you have to clear "Main quest Ch.14 The two maids" to join this event.

[h3]② Let's collect event items![/h3]
How to collect the event items "Prayer Beads" and "Requiem Bracelet"

[h3]③ Progress the event and you will be able to trade the items you collected with other great items![/h3]
*You can collect up to 99999 items in the event.

[h3]Event Achievements[/h3]
Clear the event limited achievements to earn a special title!
You can find the achievements from YOME > Navi > Achievements!

[h3]Event Panel Mission is here![/h3]
You can get rewards by clearing missions related to the event quest.
During the event, tap the icon on the left of your screen to display the missions.

[h3]Event limited item[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/9875052b8ee863bb88f2444e2b85a9f7a7ffd176.png[/img]
The special rewards for this event are Asura Head and Ganesha Plushie!!
Getting them may bring you good fortune!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212271/24a9f1930385e83d557e442f513793972455efe2.png[/img]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
*The event period is subject to change without notice.
*There are no voices in this event.
Back to the List

Those with secret knowledge. Deep mysteries follow the unknown elements.
